description: This file defines a final class MacNodeLocationService which implements location services using CLLocationManager, including handling timeouts, location updates, and failures. It acts as a location provider with async/await support and conforms to CLLocationManagerDelegate and a custom LocationServiceCommon protocol.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A location service class that manages location updates and handles timeout logic, designed for use in a Swift concurrency context.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Fetches the current location asynchronously with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Utility method to run an async operation with a specified timeout, cancelling if timeout occurs.
